idea_code_consistency.label: partial
idea_code_consistency.justification: The code implements the core DAHD decomposition pipeline: entity extraction, dependency graph construction, centrality computation, topological layering, an entity registry, and sub-header generation. However, several key components from the idea are missing or not integrated: the planned pilot evaluation against HFDecomposer with MoJoFM, F1, ARI, NMI, coverage, and cycle-rate metrics is absent; core-periphery separation is computed but never used; entity coverage verification is implemented but not called or surfaced; LLM semantic refinement is only an optional flag with no shown implementation; and topological layer internals and include-order generation are not fully shown. Thus the main direction matches, but important idea elements are dropped or unverified.
